title: MuViSU Retreat 2026
text:
Welcome to the retreat of MuViSU, the Multivariate Visualisation and Statistical Understanding group. See github.com/MuViSU for more about the organisation and its materials.

title: MuViSU Retreat 2026
text:
Participant activity
Each participant should plan to bring a research activity to work on during the retreat, or be prepared to work with one or two other participants on their proposed activity. Think about what might be achieved in the 1.5 day time frame, and what might be an activity where getting input from others will be especially useful. For example, students could focus on a particular section of their thesis, which might involve literature review, writing, an application or software development. Faculty might consider some part of their current work that would benefit from some dedicated time to develop, and insights from other faculty and students, which might be a part of a research project, application, blog post, or developing teaching materials.

title: MuViSU Retreat 2026
section: What to do before the retreat
text:
What to do before the retreat

Make a post on the Retreat repo (XXX provide link) briefly describing the planned activity.
Prepare a few slides explaining the activity to show at the beginning of the retreat.
If you don’t have one, create a GitHub account, and make sure you have the most recent versions of R, and quarto on your laptop, or any other software needed.

title: Code of Conduct
text:
Code of Conduct
All participants are expected to be respectful, inclusive and welcoming, and to follow harassment-free behaviour standards throughout the retreat. Concerns can be raised with the organisers, who will address them promptly and confidentially.
